title: Positive Ext sheaf cohomology agrees with right-derived terminal evaluation
statement: Let C be a category with Grothendieck topology J [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Assume abelian-group sheafification in universe w [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], Ext groups in universe w for the abelian sheaf category, and injective resolutions in that category [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Let T be a terminal object and F any sheaf of abelian groups. For every natural number q there is an additive equivalence between Ext^(q+1)(Z_J,F), where Z_J is the constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] of lifted integers (Mathlib Sheaf.H F (q+1)), and the value at F of the (q+1)-st right-derived functor [def-sp-left-exact-additive] of evaluation at T after inclusion of sheaves into presheaves.

source.place: Cohomology on Sites, Section 21.2, Equation (21.2.0.1) and the following right-derived-functor description; identify Mathlib Sheaf.H with this definition by the constant-sheaf adjunction and the injective-resolution computation of Ext.

proof.text: The private evaluationEquiv is the composite of (constantSheafAdj J AddCommGrpCat hT).homAddEquiv and uliftZMultiplesAddEquiv. Its naturality follows from Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right and evaluation at 1. This identifies maps from the constant lifted integer sheaf with evaluation at T, additively and naturally.

Choose R = injectiveResolution F. In the integer-indexed complex R.cochainComplex, identify each HomComplex component with maps from the integer sheaf using Cochain.fromSingleEquiv, then with terminal evaluation using evaluationEquiv. The Hom groups have universe max u w, so compose with AddEquiv.ulift.symm and lift evaluation by AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u,w}. HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents packages the isomorphism. Its differential equation follows from Cochain.fromSingleMk_surjective, Cochain.δ_fromSingleMk and evaluationEquiv_naturality.

Compose R.extAddEquivCohomologyClass with the inverse of HomComplex.leftHomologyData.homologyIso, homologyFunctor.mapIso of complexEvaluationIso, the evaluation complex short complex mapHomologyIso for the exact universe-lift functor, and that functor applied to the inverse of R.isoRightDerivedObjCochainComplex E (q+1) from the proved source module WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.DerivedCategory.RightDerivedFunctor.PlusSingle. Convert the resulting group isomorphism to an additive equivalence and compose with AddEquiv.ulift to remove the universe lift. All three original argument steps are implemented; no unresolved intermediate theorem is introduced.

theorem cohomology_nonempty_addEquiv_rightDerived_evaluation_succ
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{w}] [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{w})]
    [HasInjectiveResolutions (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{w})]
    (T : C) (hT : Limits.IsTerminal T) (F : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{w}) (q : ℕ) :
    Nonempty
      (Sheaf.H F (q + 1) ≃+
        (((sheafToPresheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{w} ⋙
          (evaluation Cᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{w}).obj (Opposite.op T)).rightDerived
            (q + 1)).obj F))
